Hero.eyebrow: Equestrian club — Vence · Col de Vence
Hero.h1Line2: in the heart of the Préalpes d'Azur
Hero.subtitle: Family pony rides from age 2, riding lessons, school holiday camps and trail rides. Open every day.

Intro.heading: An exceptional training, a shared passion
Intro.paragraph1: Pénélope has been riding since the age of five. Over her career, she has had the chance to work with and for great names in horse riding, including the renowned Bartabas and his Théâtre équestre Zingaro. From these encounters, she has drawn a rare sense of rigour in the selection, training and care of her horses.
Intro.paragraph2: Her philosophy today: to pass on what she has received — the complete apprenticeship of the horse. From the youngest pony riders to advanced competitors, every rider finds their place at Fort Apache.

WhyUs.heading: Why choose Fort Apache
WhyUs.subtitle: An equestrian club unlike any other — by its history, its team, and its setting.
WhyUs.item1Desc: Over forty years welcoming families and sharing our love of horses, in a spirit of transmission and constant improvement.
WhyUs.item2Desc: Pénélope, founder, has worked alongside leading figures of the equestrian world, including the renowned Bartabas and his Théâtre équestre Zingaro.
WhyUs.item3Desc: An exceptional setting at the Col de Vence, 40 minutes from the sea, within a preserved regional natural park.
WhyUs.item4Desc: The club welcomes you all year round, from 10am to 5pm. Lessons, rides, camps — the choice is yours.

BaladePoney.imageAlt: Pony ride at the Col de Vence
BaladePoney.heading: Go on a pony ride
BaladePoney.paragraph1Middle: at Fort Apache. We welcome children
BaladePoney.paragraph1After: for rides through wild countryside, on marked trails in the heart of the Col de Vence.
BaladePoney.paragraph2: From 10 minutes to several hours: after a short safety briefing, you set off with your children on the back of a pony that you lead by hand. From Shetlands for the youngest to large ponies for teenagers.
BaladePoney.bullet2: CE-compliant helmets and safety stirrups provided
BaladePoney.bullet3: Ponies carefully selected for their gentleness, for over 40 years
BaladePoney.bullet4: In the heart of the Préalpes d'Azur Regional Natural Park

FounderJourney.heading: A founder trained by the masters of the discipline
FounderJourney.quote: Over a lifetime in the saddle, Pénélope had the chance to work with and for some of the most respected names in horse riding, including Bartabas and his renowned Théâtre équestre Zingaro.
FounderJourney.paragraph: From each of these encounters, she has drawn a rare sense of rigour in the selection, training and care of her horses. A philosophy she now passes on to every rider, from the youngest beginner to the advanced competitor.
FounderJourney.link: Meet the team and the club →

Activities.heading: Activities for every rider
Activities.subtitle: Whether you are a complete beginner or an experienced rider, we offer an activity suited to your wishes and level.

SocialWall.heading: Follow the club
SocialWall.subtitle: Photos, shared moments, behind-the-scenes and news — find us daily on our social media.

Testimonials.heading: What our riders say
Testimonials.quote1: You really learn everything about caring for a horse, not just riding. Whatever happens — feeding, illness — you know what to do.
Testimonials.quote2: It's a club where coming here actually means something. You learn to know your horse, to understand horse riding. The horse truly matters.
Testimonials.quote3: When I'm having small problems, at school or with friends, I go see the horses. It helps me, it calms me down.

CTABanner.heading: Ready to saddle up? Get in touch
CTABanner.paragraph: Our team is here to help you find the right programme — from the youngest pony rider to the seasoned competitor. Open every day from 10am to 5pm.

Metadata.title: Equestrian activities — Pony rides, lessons and camps
Metadata.description: All our activities at Fort Apache (Vence, 06140): family pony rides, group and private lessons, pony school, trail rides, school holiday camps and competition riding.

Header.title: Find your equestrian passion
Header.subtitle: A range of activities for every age — from a family pony ride to competition-level training.

Featured.heading: Pony rides
Featured.text: The Fort Apache signature experience: guided pony rides in the heart of the Col de Vence. Ideal for families, even with no prior experience.

Cards.groupLessonsDesc: Learn and progress in a group, in a friendly atmosphere. One-hour sessions by level.
Cards.privateLessonsDesc: A dedicated instructor just for you. Perfect for focused progress or returning to the saddle.
Cards.ponySchoolDesc: For children aged 4 to 8: first contact with the pony, games, horse care and small courses.
Cards.trailRidesDesc: For experienced riders: multi-hour or half-day rides along the trails of the Col de Vence.
Cards.campsDesc: Autumn, Christmas, winter, Easter, summer: themed camps of 3 to 5 days for all levels.
Cards.boardingDesc: Looking to own your own horse or pony? Pénélope advises you on choosing, caring for, training and looking after your mount, with personalised follow-up.
Cards.competitionsDesc: Show jumping, dressage, cross-country, Western riding, side-saddle, driving, vaulting, skijoring, horse-ball — at Fort Apache, you practise the discipline you love.

CtaBanner.heading: Interested in an activity?
CtaBanner.paragraph: Get in touch so we can discuss and find the right programme for you.
